question: Which recipes change continuously when the combinatorics change, i.e. when a small face or short edge shrinks to nothing?
hypothesis: No recipe is continuous under every transition. In the limit, vertex truncation of a valence-q vertex adds +3q in new vertices and -2q in new edges, so R4ve is continuous under truncation; by polarity R4fe is continuous under raising a flat pyramid on a face. R1, R2 and flag jump under all three transitions, and R4ve jumps under an edge bevel.
changed_factor: the transition parameter s, one family at a time (recipes compared side by side)
